web.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · A crazy thinking model - Hugging Face
web.description:
## A crazy thinking model
```
#!/bin/bash
/home/<YOUR_USER>/tabbyAPI/start.sh \
    --model-name Qwen3.8-27B-exl3-5.0bpw \
    --max-seq-len 131072 \
    --cache-size 262144 \
    --cache-mode "6,6" \
    --override-preset qwen38 \
    --vision true \
    --tool-format qwen3_coder \
    --max-batch-size 2 \
    --tensor-parallel true \
    --draft-mode mtp
```
